name: Can a criminal conviction be cleared from my record?

mainEntity.name: Can a criminal conviction be cleared from my record?

acceptedAnswer.text: California law permits certain convictions to be expunged if you’ve completed your sentence and meet eligibility requirements. Expungement helps restore rights, employment prospects, and privacy. A lawyer can guide you through the petition and hearing process.selfhelp.courts.ca​
